build_lightconv_model: build a LightConv encoder-decoder model for machine translation using lightweight or dynamic convolutions
build_lightconv_encoder: build a LightConvEncoder with configurable convolution kernel sizes and GLU activation for sequence encoding
build_lightconv_decoder: build a LightConvDecoder with incremental state support and encoder attention for autoregressive decoding
configure_lightconv_architecture: configure a LightConv model architecture with custom encoder layers, attention heads, and kernel size lists
review_lightconv_layer: review the LightConvEncoderLayer or LightConvDecoderLayer to understand convolution, attention, and FFN sub-layers
